The '''Eleventh Fleet''' was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[third Galactic War]].

==History==
In the year [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> during the [[third Galactic War]], the Eleventh Fleet stopped at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] on its way to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to aid in the defense of the [[Meridian Complex]]. However, while on Onderon, it was targeted by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which aimed to destroy it so that it could not be able to continue on to Corellia.<ref name="PalaceIntrigue" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught}}
However, the Empire's plans to destroy the fleet were [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|stopped]] by the [[Alliance Commander]], who interrupted [[Darth Savik]]'s [[Darth Savik's remote droid|droids]] before they could turn Onderon's [[Anti-aircraft gun]]s against the fleet and destroy it.<ref name="PalaceIntrigue" />

Following this, the fleet arrived to defend against the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|attack]] on the Meridian Complex, and helped to successfully fight off the Imperial Fleets.<ref name="Objective Meridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Objective Meridian|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RepublicShipsFallOnOnderon-Onslaught.png|thumb|250px|Destroyed ships of the 11th Fleet crashing onto the surface of Onderon in the Imperial scenario.]]
The Eleventh Fleet appears during the ''Onslaught'' expansion for the game ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''. If the player character is a Republic Loyalist or an Imperial Saboteur, they will save the fleet from being destroyed by the Empire.<ref name="PalaceIntrigue" /> However, if the player character is an Imperial Loyalist or a Republic Saboteur, they will successfully destroy the fleet and prevent it from being present during the defense of the Meridian Complex.<ref name="TheAttackonIziz">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Imperial|The Attack on Iziz|Onderon}}</ref>
